metaDescription: GTA Christmas Lighting won Toronto's 2026 award. See its free design consult, single-day install, January takedown and rental-or-buy programs.
summary: GTA Christmas Lighting serves Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville and Burlington with custom seasonal and permanent LED lighting installations. The company offers both rental and purchase programs, along with a free design consultation before any work begins.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: GTA Christmas Lighting installs custom holiday displays, tree lighting, interior decorations and commercial installations across a wide swath of the Greater Toronto Area. The company also offers permanent LED lighting alongside seasonal Christmas installs, giving homeowners a choice between an annual display and a year-round system. Custom displays and commercial installation extend the company's work beyond typical residential rooflines.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: The process starts with a free design consultation, followed by installation the company describes as completed in a single day. Mid-season maintenance is included, so a burnt-out section of lights does not sit unaddressed through the holidays, and takedown happens in January with secure storage for the season. Both rental and purchase programs are offered, making professional-grade displays accessible at different price points.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One reviewer said working with the company was super easy, noting that handling everything from installation to removal made the season stress-free and calling it totally worth it. Another described the experience as a joy, saying the design, installation and removal were handled with no hassle and made their Christmas decorations simple and enjoyable.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: GTA Christmas Lighting serves Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville and Burlington. Homeowners outside these named cities should confirm coverage before booking.

strengths: Offers both seasonal rental and outright purchase programs for holiday lighting.
Free design consultation before any installation commitment.
Advertises single-day installation with mid-season maintenance included.
Also installs permanent LED lighting alongside seasonal Christmas displays.
considerations: Seasonal installation and January takedown mean booking early secures preferred dates before the season fills.
A wide service footprint across the GTA means confirming your specific city's coverage before booking.
Rental programs typically cost less upfront but do not build equity in owned lighting over time.
bestFor: Homeowners wanting a hands-off, fully installed and removed display
Businesses needing commercial holiday installation across the GTA
Anyone comparing a seasonal rental against buying permanent LED lighting
Households wanting interior decorating alongside exterior lights
questionsToAsk: How does pricing compare between the rental program and purchasing my own display?
What is included in the free design consultation, and is there any obligation after?
How is a mid-season outage reported and how quickly is it fixed?
Where and how are the lights stored between the January takedown and next season?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means GTA Christmas Lighting was selected as the top business in the Holiday & Christmas Lighting category for Toronto through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Can I rent instead of buying a display?
faq.a: Yes. The company offers both rental and purchase programs, giving homeowners flexibility depending on budget and how long they plan to use the same display.

faq.q: Do they also do permanent lighting?
faq.a: Yes. Permanent lighting is listed alongside seasonal Christmas installation, so homeowners can choose a year-round system instead of an annual display.
The company lists Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville and Burlington as its service area.
